name: Walnut cleaning cabinet 2ft

placement.allowed_scaling: Rigid translation and Z rotation only; no scaling.

description: Walnut cleaning cupboard with upper shelf and clear lower volume for tall tools; no clothing rail.
rights: Original project geometry; attribution: Homes project contributors

derived_from.basis: Upper shelf, doors and case retained; hanging rail removed for tall cleaning tools. Warm-walnut/v001 finish and physical-meter UVs added.

host_integration.required: Adopting home must check installation, service space and operating envelopes.

installation.mounting: Floor-supported 2×2×8ft cleaning cupboard; host supplies anti-tip anchorage and accessible opening. Lower storage is clear of hanging rail.

operating_envelope.basis: Original .28956m door leaves with rounded concept operator allowance; hinges not animated.

service_requirements: Preserve standing space and door operation; coordinate child-safe cleaning-product storage, ventilation and leak containment with selected contents. No load or accessibility certification.
